# Casa Colletti, Casoli di Camaiore, Tuscany

> Casa Colletti is a 300-year-old holiday house for up to 8 guests in Casoli, a car-free hill village in the municipality of Camaiore (province of Lucca, Tuscany, Italy), 500 m above the Versilia coast. Hiking trails into the Alpi Apuane start at the front door, the climbing crags of the Camaiorese are nearby, and the beach at Lido di Camaiore is about 30 minutes by car. Hosted by Stefanie and Lorenzo.

## Key facts

- Location: Via Colletti 203-204, Casoli di Camaiore (LU), Toscana, Italy. Elevation 500 m.
- Size: 140 m² on two floors, 3 bedrooms, 8 beds, up to 8 guests, 1 bathroom (shower and bathtub) plus a separate WC.
- The whole house is rented to one group: two terraces and a garden with views to the sea and the Alpi Apuane.
- Equipment: kitchen with gas stove and dishwasher, fireplace, gas heating, washing machine, Wi-Fi, workspace with two monitors.
- Access: car-free village. Free parking about 350 m below the house, then about 160 steps (around 10 minutes on foot). Not suitable for guests with limited mobility.
- Check-in from 12:00, check-out until 16:00, self check-in with a key box. Minimum stay 3 nights.
- Booking: directly by email (colletti.casoli@gmail.com) or via Airbnb.
- Registration code (CIN): IT046005C2KB378ECO.

## Activities

- Hiking from the door: Grotta all'Onda (prehistoric cave on Monte Matanna), Rifugio Alto Matanna, Monte Matanna (1317 m), old mule track to Metato, waterfalls and natural pools of Candalla.
- Climbing: Il Camaiorese, more than 50 crags and 1500 routes, including Cannelot, Pilastro di Setriana and San Rocchino; some reachable on foot from the village.
- Beaches: Lido di Camaiore (30 min), Viareggio and Forte dei Marmi (35 min), Spiaggia della Lecciona in the Migliarino San Rossore Massaciuccoli nature park.
- Village: Casoli is known as the "paese dei graffiti" for the sgraffiti carved into its house fronts; village bar with panoramic terrace and a small shop.
- Day trips by car: Pietrasanta 25 min, Lucca 45 min, Pisa 50 min, Carrara marble quarries 60 min, Cinque Terre 1 h 30 min, Florence 1 h 45 min. Nearest airport: Pisa, about 50 min.
